note: Marion County SC publishes zoning only through its WTH Think GIS web viewer (marionsc.wthgis.com), which exposes no ArcGIS REST endpoint I could find (/rest/services returns 404). The county zoning ordinance refers to an Official Zoning Map but no queryable service of it was found. City of Mullins publishes its zoning map only as a PDF; City of Marion publishes only its ordinance PDF (its ArcGIS 'OfficialZoningDistricts' item is City of Marion, North Carolina, not SC). ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Marion County SC zoning returned no matching service.
